name: Kingsview Minerals Ltd.
summary: Kingsview Minerals Ltd. is a Canadian firm engaged in the acquisition and exploration of mineral resource properties, primarily concentrating its efforts on discovering gold deposits. Its principal asset is the Echum property, an extensive site spanning approximately 7,691 hectares within Ontario's Wawa Gold Corridor. Established in 2018, the company initially operated as 1181630 B.C., changing its corporate identity to Kingsview Minerals Ltd. in August 2020. The company's headquarters are located in Vancouver, Canada.
